Individual exposure and secondary parameters

pk_exposure.Rd

Derives individual secondary PK parameters from the empirical Bayes estimates of a run (half-lives, volume of distribution at steady state) and simulates the individual steady-state profile for a dosing regimen to obtain Cmax, Tmax, Cmin and AUC over the dosing interval. AUC_ss is computed as dose / CL (linear pharmacokinetics; CL is CL/F for oral data) and AUC_ss_sim by the trapezoidal rule on the simulated profile.

Usage

pk_exposure(
  run,
  dose,
  ii = 24,
  n_doses = 14,
  dt = 0.1,
  data = NULL,
  proj = NULL
)

Arguments

run

A completed run (reference or id).

dose

Dose amount per administration (same unit as AMT in the data).

ii

Dosing interval (same time unit as the data).

n_doses

Number of doses before the evaluated interval; the last interval is evaluated. Use a number large enough to reach steady state.

dt

Time step of the simulated profile.

data

Dataset with the subject covariates. Default: registered data.

proj

A pk_project object. Defaults to the current project.

Value

A tibble with one row per subject: individual parameters, secondary parameters, exposure metrics and the covariates of the dictionary.

Details

Dose and concentration units follow the data (for example dose in the unit of AMT, concentration in dose unit per volume unit). The result is stored in models/<run>/eval/exposure.rds.
